sourceCode: _pretenured_newFromArray: anArray   "Fast implementation. Just use a copy of the argument as a storage.	No need to copy the elements one by one."   ^ self basicNew setContents: anArray _pretenured_asNewArray

_pretenured_readHeader   "Read a record, presumably a header and return the header field names.	This should normally be called only at the beginning and only once.	This sets the fieldCount (but fieldAccessors overrides fieldCount)."   | names |   names := Array _pretenured_streamContents: [ :out |                  [ self readAtEndOrEndOfLine ] whileFalse: [                        out nextPut: self _pretenured_readField.                        (self readSeparator and: [                            self atEnd or: [ self peekEndOfLine ] ])                           ifTrue: [ out nextPut: emptyFieldValue ] ] ].   self fieldCount: names size.   ^ names

_pretenured_at: key put: anObject   "Set the value at key to be anObject.  If key is not found, create a	new entry for key and set is value to anObject. Answer anObject."   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#blue; yourself)"   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; at: #color put: #red; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#red; yourself)"   | index assoc |   index := self findElementOrNil: key.   assoc := array at: index.   assoc      ifNil: [            self               atNewIndex: index               put: (Association _pretenured_key: key value: anObject) ]      ifNotNil: [ assoc value: anObject ].   ^ anObject

_pretenured_rows: rowNumber columns: columnNumber   "Create a Matrix of rowNUmber rows and columnNumber columns."   ^ self        rows: rowNumber        columns: columnNumber        contents: (Array newTenured: rowNumber * columnNumber)
_pretenured_readRowsWith: aReader   ^ self includeRowNames        ifTrue: [ self readRowsAndRowNamesWith: aReader ]        ifFalse: [ self _pretenured_readOnlyRowsWith: aReader ]
_pretenured_on: aCollection   "Answer an instance of me, streaming over the elements of aCollection."   ^ self basicNewTenured on: aCollection
initialize   super initialize.   contents := Array2D newTenured
_pretenured_writeStream   ^ WriteStream _pretenured_on: self
_pretenured_asOrderedCollection   ^ OrderedCollection _pretenured_newFromArray: self

_pretenured_as: aSimilarClass   "Create an object of class aSimilarClass that has similar contents to the receiver if the object is not already an instance of this class."   aSimilarClass == self class ifTrue: [ ^ self ].   ^ aSimilarClass _pretenured_newFrom: self

_pretenured_columnNames: aCollection   "Sets the column names of a DataFrame with contents of the collection aCollection"   | type |   aCollection size = self numberOfColumns ifFalse: [      SizeMismatch signal: 'Wrong number of column names' ].   aCollection _pretenured_asSet size = aCollection size ifFalse: [      Error signal: 'All column names must be distinct' ].   self columnNames ifNotNil: [         self columnNames _pretenured_withIndexDo: [               :currentColumnName               :i |               type := dataTypes at: currentColumnName.               dataTypes removeKey: currentColumnName.               dataTypes _pretenured_at: (aCollection at: i) put: type ] ].   columnNames := aCollection _pretenured_asOrderedCollection
_pretenured_asNewArray   ^ self clone
_pretenured_initialize: aPoint   contents := Array2D _pretenured_rows: aPoint x columns: aPoint y

_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays   | numberOfRows numberOfColumns dfInternal |   numberOfRows := anArrayOfArrays size.   numberOfColumns := 0.   1 to: numberOfRows do: [ :index |         numberOfColumns := numberOfColumns max:                               (anArrayOfArrays at: index) size ].   dfInternal := self newTenured: numberOfRows @ numberOfColumns.   1 to: numberOfRows do: [ :i |         1 to: numberOfColumns do: [ :j |               dfInternal                  at: i                  at: j                  put:                  ((anArrayOfArrays at: i) asArray at: j ifAbsent: nil) ] ].   ^ dfInternal
_pretenured_to: stop   "Answer an Interval from the receiver up to the argument, stop,	incrementing by 1."   ^ Interval _pretenured_from: self to: stop by: 1
_pretenured_withAll: aCollection   "Create a new collection containing all the elements from aCollection."   ^ (self newTenured: aCollection size)        addAll: aCollection;        yourself

_pretenured_readField   | field |   field := self peekQuote               ifTrue: [ self readQuotedField ]               ifFalse: [ self _pretenured_readUnquotedField ].   (field ~= emptyFieldValue and: [ emptyFieldInput notNil ]) ifTrue: [      (emptyFieldInput value: field) ifTrue: [ ^ emptyFieldValue ] ].   ^ field

_pretenured_makeRoomAtLast   "Make some empty slots at the end of the array. If we have more than 50% free space, then just move the elements, so that the last 50% of the slots are free, otherwise add new free slots to the end by growing. Precondition: lastIndex = array size"   | tally newFirstIndex newLastIndex |   tally := self size.   tally * 2 >= lastIndex ifTrue: [ ^ self _pretenured_growAtLast ].   tally = 0 ifTrue: [ ^ self resetTo: 1 ].   newLastIndex := lastIndex // 2.   newFirstIndex := newLastIndex - lastIndex + firstIndex.   array      replaceFrom: newFirstIndex      to: newLastIndex      with: array      startingAt: firstIndex.   array from: newLastIndex + 1 to: lastIndex put: nil.   firstIndex := newFirstIndex.   lastIndex := newLastIndex
_pretenured_key: newKey value: newValue   "Answer an instance of me with the arguments as the key and value of	the association."   ^ self basicNewTenured key: newKey value: newValue
initialize   super initialize.   dataTypes := Dictionary new.   contents := DataFrameInternal newTenured.   self _pretenured_setDefaultRowColumnNames.   self calculateDataTypes

_pretenured_calculateDataType   | types |   types := Set newTenured.   self do: [ :elem | elem ifNotNil: [ types add: elem class ] ].   types ifNotEmpty: [ :classes |         | result |         result := classes                      inject: classes anyOne                      into: [ :commonSuperclass :each |                         self                            leastCommonSuperclassOf: commonSuperclass                            and: each ].         "If we cannot detect the type, we configure it as Object."         ^ (result withAllSuperclasses includes: String)              ifTrue: [ Object ]              ifFalse: [ result ] ].   ^ UndefinedObject

_pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock   "Just like do: except that the iteration index supplies the second argument to the block"   "(Array streamContents: [:stream| #(11 22 13) withIndexDo: [ :each :i | stream nextPut: (each * each + i)]]) >>> #(122 486 172)"   1 to: self size do: [ :index |   elementAndIndexBlock value: (self at: index) value: index ]

_pretenured_streamContents: blockWithArg   "Build an instance of the receiver by writing elements to a stream.	More specifically: blockWithArg will be given a WriteStream on an instance of the receiver.	Inside blockWithArg you write elements to the stream to build up the collection.	At the end, the contents of the stream up to that point will be returned.	Note that the underlying collection grows as needed."   "(Array streamContents: [ :out | out nextPut: 1; nextPutAll: #(2 3 4); nextPut: 5 ]) >>> #(1 2 3 4 5)"   ^ self _pretenured_new: 100 streamContents: blockWithArg
_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays   ^ self newTenured _pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays

_pretenured_asSet   "Answer a Set whose elements are the unique elements of the receiver."   "{1. 2} asSet =    {2. 1} asSet >>> true"   "{1. 2} asSet = {1. 2. 2} asSet >>> true"   "{1. 2} asSet = {1. 2. 3} asSet >>> false"   "{} asSet = Set new >>> true"   ^ Set _pretenured_withAll: self

_pretenured_asArrayOfColumns   "Converts DataFrame to the array of columns"   "(#(#(1 2) #(3 4)) asDataFrame asArrayOfColumns) >>> (#(#(1 3) #(2 4)))"   "(#(#(r1c1 r1c2) #(r2c1 r2c2)) asDataFrame asArrayOfColumns) >>> (#(#(r1c1 r2c1) #(r1c2 r2c2)))"   ^ contents _pretenured_asArrayOfColumns

_pretenured_from: startInteger to: stopInteger by: stepInteger   "Answer an instance of me, starting at startNumber, ending at	stopNumber, and with an interval increment of stepNumber."   ^ self newTenured        setFrom: startInteger        to: stopInteger        by: stepInteger

_pretenured_calculateDataTypes   self _pretenured_asArrayOfColumns _pretenured_doWithIndex: [         :column         :i |         self dataTypes            _pretenured_at: (self columnNames at: i)            put: column _pretenured_calculateDataType ]

_pretenured_readUnquotedField   (self atEnd or: [ self peekSeparator or: [ self peekEndOfLine ] ])      ifTrue: [ ^ emptyFieldValue ].   ^ self _pretenured_stringStreamContents: [ :stream |           [           self atEnd or: [              self peekSeparator or: [ self peekEndOfLine ] ] ]              whileFalse: [ stream nextPut: self nextChar ] ]
_pretenured_doWithIndex: elementAndIndexBlock   "Use the new version with consistent naming"   ^ self _pretenured_withIndexDo: elementAndIndexBlock

_pretenured_asOrderedCollection   "Answer an OrderedCollection whose elements are the elements of the	receiver. The order in which elements are added depends on the order	in which the receiver enumerates its elements. In the case of unordered	collections, the ordering is not necessarily the same for multiple	requests for the conversion."   "(10 to: 25 by: 5) asOrderedCollection >>> #(10 15 20 25) asOrderedCollection"   "'foo' asOrderedCollection = #($f $o $o) asOrderedCollection >>> true"   "'foo' asOrderedCollection = #($o $o $f) asOrderedCollection >>> false"   ^ self _pretenured_as: OrderedCollection

_pretenured_growAtLast   "Add new empty slots to the end of array, while keeping the empty slots at the front."   "OrderedCollection new capacity >>> 10"   "(OrderedCollection new growAtLast; capacity) >>> 20"   | newArray |   newArray := self class arrayType newTenured:                  (array size * 2 max: 1).   newArray      replaceFrom: firstIndex      to: lastIndex      with: array      startingAt: firstIndex.   array := newArray

_pretenured_asArrayOfColumns   "Converts DataFrameInternal to the array of columns"   ^ (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfColumns) collect: [ :j |           (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfRows) collect: [ :i |              self at: i at: j ] ]

_pretenured_stringStreamContents: block   "Like String streamContents: block	but reusing the underlying buffer for improved efficiency"   stringStream ifNil: [      stringStream := (String new: 32) _pretenured_writeStream ].   stringStream reset.   block value: stringStream.   ^ stringStream contents

_pretenured_readColumnNamesWith: aReader   "Set the receiver's column names if they were not manually set"   columnNames ifNil: [ columnNames := aReader _pretenured_readHeader ].   self includeRowNames ifTrue: [      columnNames := columnNames copyWithoutFirst ]
_pretenured_privateRowNames: anArray   "I am a private method skipping the assertions when my internal mecanisms know they can skip them."   rowNames := anArray _pretenured_asOrderedCollection

_pretenured_newFrom: aCollection   "Answer an instance of me containing the same elements as aCollection."   | newCollection |   newCollection := self newTenured: aCollection size.   newCollection addAll: aCollection.   ^ newCollection   "	OrderedCollection newFrom: {1. 2. 3}	{1. 2. 3} as: OrderedCollection	{4. 2. 7} as: SortedCollection"

_pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames   ^ anArrayOfArrays        ifNotEmpty: [              (self _pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays)                 _pretenured_columnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames;                 yourself ]        ifEmpty: [ self withColumnNames: anArrayOfColumnNames ]
_pretenured_readOnlyRowsWith: aReader   rows := OrderedCollection newTenured.   [ aReader atEnd ] whileFalse: [ rows _pretenured_add: aReader next ]

_pretenured_add: newObject   "Add a new object at the end of the collection, and returns the object itself"   "((OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) add: 43; yourself) asArray >>> #(42 43)"   "Add returns the object itself"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42) >>> 42"   "You may want to use yourself to return the collection itself"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) class >>> OrderedCollection"   "(OrderedCollection new add: 42; yourself) size >>> 1"   ^ self _pretenured_addLast: newObject

_pretenured_initializeRows: anArrayOfArrays   contents := DataFrameInternal _pretenured_withRows: anArrayOfArrays.   self _pretenured_setDefaultRowColumnNames.   self _pretenured_calculateDataTypes
newTenured: aPoint   ^ self newTenured _pretenured_initialize: aPoint

_pretenured_addLast: newObject   "Add newObject to the end of the receiver. Answer newObject."   lastIndex = array size ifTrue: [ self _pretenured_makeRoomAtLast ].   lastIndex := lastIndex + 1.   ^ array at: lastIndex put: newObject
_pretenured_setDefaultRowColumnNames   self _pretenured_privateRowNames:      (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfRows).   self _pretenured_columnNames:      (1 _pretenured_to: self numberOfColumns)

_pretenured_new: newSize streamContents: blockWithArg   "A variant of #streamContents: where the initial or even final size is given to optimize memory consumption"   "(Array new: 3 streamContents: [ :out | 3 timesRepeat: [ out nextPut: 42 ] ]) >>> #(42 42 42)"   | stream |   stream := WriteStream _pretenured_on:                (self streamSpecies new: newSize).   blockWithArg value: stream.   "If the write position of stream is at the end of the internal buffer of stream (originalContents),	we can return it directly instead of making a copy as contents would do"   ^ stream position = stream originalContents size        ifTrue: [ stream originalContents ]        ifFalse: [ stream contents ]
recordClassNew: size   ^ recordClass newTenured: size

collect: aBlock   | nextValue result |   result := self species newTenured: self size.   nextValue := start.   1 to: result size do: [ :i |         result at: i put: (aBlock value: nextValue).         nextValue := nextValue + step ].   ^ result

readFromInternal: aFileReference   "Read data frame from a CSV file"   | stream reader df |   stream := aFileReference readStream.   reader := NeoCSVReader on: stream.   reader separator: self separator.   self _pretenured_readColumnNamesWith: reader.   self _pretenured_readRowsWith: reader.   reader close.   df := self createDataFrame.   ^ df

cull: anArg   "Execute the receiver with one or zero arguments depending on the receiver"   "([ 12 ] cull: 13)>>> 12 "   "([:x | x + 12] cull: 3)>>> 15"   <reflection:   'Message sending and code execution - Runtime and Evaluation'>   ^ numArgs = 0        ifTrue: [ self value ]        ifFalse: [ self value: anArg ]
